$comment: Dated debt, the same shape as coverage-debt and flakeregister: owner, expires, reason. Keyed by the exact file:line the gate prints, so an entry is copied from a red run. A line that moves is a new red run. Expiry is the point: this is a debt, not an allowlist.

buttons.reason: The export button is px-3 py-1 (~35px tall). Found by MAJ-03 when the gate started covering packages/. Not in the P0 batch: fixing it moves the scoreboard baseline, which is a separate decision.
The 'Reload' button in the update toast is px-3 py-1. The scoreboard app never had a touch gate before MAJ-03; not in the P0 batch.
The 'Later' button in the update toast is px-2 py-1 (~28px tall). Same as above: newly visible, out of the P0 batch.
